summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Labor to publicly report labor statistics online monthly, including data disaggregated by geography, race, ethnicity, and gender, and modernizes language in existing laws related to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on modernizing the duties and reporting requirements of the Bureau of Labor Statistics, specifically mandating the collection and public reporting of disaggregated labor statistics, including unemployment data by demographics. While it doesn't directly create new labor laws or affect union power, it enhances the data available regarding the labor market, which can inform discussions and policies related to labor. The bill is primarily about data collection and transparency, not about the substance of labor rights or employer flexibility.
